capabilities: Annotate PDFs with handwriting, highlights, shapes and images
Export annotated PDF copies while keeping originals intact
Create handwritten notebooks with paper templates and custom covers
Recognize and beautify handwriting via OCR (Pro)
Answer questions about selected text with AI (Pro)
extras: Proprietary software; Free works offline with no account or telemetry, Pro is a separate paid edition. Some Pro features need a resource download or configured AI service; disable Free in the vault before switching to Pro. Requires Obsidian 1.15.1+; PDF rendering on iPhone/iPad needs iOS/iPadOS 18+. Keep each PDF together with its companion annotation file and attached images when backing up.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or highlight on PDFs or to keep handwritten notebooks beside regular notes.

relations.evidence: 另行安装兼容的墨词 InkLex Pro 后，可扩展 PDF 阅读与词汇学习体验

summary: PDF annotator and handwritten notebook tool for Obsidian; saves annotations in the vault, exports annotated PDFs; Pro adds Markdown handwriting, OCR, AI Q&A.
